title: Have you noticed how many people’s home theater setups the screen is either way too small or way too far away?

commenti.body: The biggest insult to home theaters is that 95% of people put their TVs too high. The center of the screen is supposed to be at eye level. It's surprising how many new construction homes still have dedicated TV spaces above fireplaces... how can you possibly enjoy a film when you have to do neck yoga just to see the screen? It's offensive.
